maddeler.e:
نقتدر (form VIII)
# نَقْتَدِرُ (naqtadiru) /naq.ta.di.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَدَرَ (iqtadara)
# نَقْتَدِرَ (naqtadira) /naq.ta.di.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَدَرَ (iqtadara)
# نَقْتَدِرْ (naqtadir) /naq.ta.dir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَدَرَ (iqtadara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
